item.title: Here's how the Oblivion Remastered attributes list is different from the original
item.content:encoded: Oblivion Remastered keeps the same list of attributes, but changes how some of them work.

item.title: Former Forza Horizon creative director reveals his studio's debut racer, which is still alive despite losing Amazon support
item.content:encoded: Clutch will be fully revealed on Friday during the Summer Game Fest showcase, but we got our first look at it today.

item.title: Part of me wishes we could see the Subnautica 2 the devs scrapped: The Dwarf Fortress of ecosystem simulators
item.content:encoded: But given it's sold a gajillion copies, they probably made the right move.

item.title: AMD is considering a Ryzen 5 9600X3D 'later this year' but its value for gaming could suffer against its own stiff competition
item.content:encoded: It might struggle to differentiate itself from other AMD competition.

item.title: Maingear MG-1 Mk.II (2026) review
item.content:encoded: The highest of high-end gaming PCs, with the biggest of price tags, but with a somewhat average chassis.

item.title: 'People talk about AI reducing jobs, complete nonsense': Nvidia's Jensen Huang criticises economic doomerism on GTC stage
item.content:encoded: I'm not sure I agree, guv.

item.title: 'Tell me that's not R2D2. Tell me that's not robotics': Jensen Huang thinks the future of personal computing is letting AI agents run your PC
item.content:encoded: "We're going to redefine how people think about computers."

item.title: Minecraft dappled forest update: everything you need to know about the next new biome
item.content:encoded: The third game drop of 2026 will add an autumnal biome and yet another new set of wood blocks.

item.title: Google is raising an army of 32 million mosquitoes like some kind of Metal Gear Solid villain
item.content:encoded: But it's for a good cause.

item.title: Excess often sells in the world of gaming PCs, but Asus' new 3000 W power supply makes little sense for even the wealthiest of whales
item.content:encoded: When is a gaming PSU not a gaming PSU? When it's an Asus ROG Thor 3000 W Titanium III Edition 20.

item.title: Overwatch is changing the requirements for its rarest anniversary event reward after realising playing 240 games over 3 weeks may be too much of a grind

item.title: Keychron's on-the-fly optical/Hall effect mouse switch is taking on Logitech over one of the few things people didn't like about the SuperStrike

item.title: DarkFlash's Computex Floatron case looks wickedly evil scientist, but I don't know if I like its 'floating base'

item.title: The Tryx Vas PC case: briefcase or air conditioning unit, you decide

item.title: Congratulations to the Paralives community for immediately making its most popular mod something called 'Parapenis'

item.title: It's wild that Destiny 2's biggest ever quality-of-life update is the one that ends the game

item.title: DarkFlash unveils another Sanrio PC case collaboration, but I dread to think what a pretty penny it will cost to build a full Cinnamoroll gaming rig
item.content:encoded: Cute as a button.

item.title: Keychron's carbon fiber concept is the skinniest keyboard I've ever typed on

item.title: While everyone seems to be ignoring the state of the economy at Computex, Arctic is keeping things real by giving us a new, affordable CPU cooler

item.title: Jen-Hsun says RTX Spark 'is 100% awesome at everything everybody expects the PC to do, and it can do more'

item.title: The Baldur's Gate remakes should scrap the original combat system and fully embrace superior turn-based fights
item.content:encoded: I have picked my hill to die on.

item.title: Fallout 76's latest Infestations update will be 'one of the easiest ways to get a four star' legendary as new type of hostile encounter spreads through Appalachia

item.title: Gabe Newell reportedly snapped 'What the f*** do I pay you for if that's your opinion?' at Valve lawyer pushing for more content moderation on Steam

item.title: Next-gen GPUs aren't around at Computex, but MSI's got a taste of what they might look like

item.content:encoded: Glass more than half full.
